question: Should ClawHub introduce a public vetted-community review status for third-party plugins, distinct from Official and automated provenance or scan signals?
rationale: The choice defines what security assurance and endorsement users may infer from a marketplace badge, which current policy intentionally leaves unresolved.

options.title: Define vetted community
options.body: Create a documented package-scoped review tier with criteria, assurance wording, expiry, revocation, and a public request workflow.

options.title: Document no manual tier
options.body: State that community packages remain unreviewed and can only display automated provenance, scanner, and moderation signals.

recommendation.title: Define vetted community
recommendation.body: Create a documented package-scoped review tier with criteria, assurance wording, expiry, revocation, and a public request workflow.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest history-backed owner of the current trust-policy specs and adjacent verification work.
